info.headline: Gale Warning issued September 24 at 11:00AM PDT until September 25 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Medford OR
info.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, south winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 6 to 7 ft at 10 seconds expected. For the Gale Warning, southwest winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 12 to 16 ft at 10 seconds expected. For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and hazardous seas 10 to 15 ft at 10 seconds expected.
* WHERE...Small Craft Advisory for all of the area Thursday evening. Gale Warning north of Reedsport late Thursday night with Hazardous Seas elsewhere. A Hazardous Seas Warning follows for all of the area into Friday afternoon.
* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 5 PM to 11 PM PDT Thursday. For the Gale Warning, from 11 PM Thursday to 5 AM PDT Friday. For the Hazardous Seas Warning, from 11 PM Thursday to 2 PM PDT Friday.
* IMPACTS...Strong winds and very steep seas could capsize or damage vessels. Low visibility conditions are expected.
* View the hazard area in detail at https://go.usa.gov/x6hks
info.instruction: Mariners should alter plans to avoid strong winds and very steep seas. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe conditions.
